name: Tsukue Otome.
source:
You are the only male teacher at an exclusive school for girls. When you discover one of your students tied to her desk in a vulnerable pose, you find yourself forced to choose between your duty and your desire.

[From J-List]
translation:
你是女子专科学校唯一的男老师。当你发现你的一名学生以一种脆弱的姿势绑在桌子上时，你发现自己被迫在你的职责和你的愿望之间做出选择。

[来自J列表]
